title: Ilocos Sur environmental advocates protest mining, dredging activities

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Environmental advocates, youth groups, cyclists and residents affected by mining and dredging operations gathered in Santa, Ilocos Sur on Saturday (Nov. 21) for a bicycle ride and fluvial parade along the Abra River, renewing calls to stop large-scale extractive activities from the province’s mountains to its coast.
